{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dark Rituals''' were [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] rituals that involved the sacrifice of living beings. They had been passed down through generations, and by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Dark Rituals were seen as barbaric and silly to many members of the Ewok tribe ruled by [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], especially the young members of the tribe including [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]]. The tribe's [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]], [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], with Chirpa's backing, performed the Dark Rituals despite protestation of the tribe's youth. Wicket's refusal to take part in the Dark Rituals earned him a banishment from participating in any ritual, including the festivals of the rain and the sun. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Logray was removed as shaman and replaced by [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]]; Logray cursed [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|the village]], predicting doom for "those who dare mock the Dark Rituals." Paploo convinced the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], who the Ewoks believed to be a golden [[Deity/Legends|deity]], to perform a cleansing ritual to lift the curse.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>
